summary: The SiteContacts module manages privacy withhold options for multiple contact types (Preceptor, Instructor, DestinationContact (DC), Placement) within a web-based administration interface. It provides UI controls for setting privacy withhold flags and specifying the number of days for information to be withheld. Users can choose to always withhold information or specify a finite period. The system supports applying privacy settings, updating, and removing them, with validation, business logic, and granularity per parent entity (e.g., Site, Course).
purpose: The purpose of SiteContacts is to allow administrators to manage the privacy withholding of contact information for various contact types related to sites or courses. This includes setting, updating, and removing withhold rules, specifying durations (or always), and determining to which destinations the rules apply. It enforces validation and ensures only authorized users can edit these settings.
actors: System (automated handlers for validation, persistence, redirection)

workflows.name: Set or Update Withhold Privacy
steps: User (with edit rights) sets or updates withhold status and days for Preceptor, DC, Instructor, or Placement.
If 'Always' is checked, days is set to -1 and day input is disabled.
If not, user enters days; input is validated to be numeric and non-negative.
On change, save function is called corresponding to the contact type.
If unchecked and record exists, it is deleted.
After saving, GetContactPrivacyInfo is called and session cache is updated.

workflows.name: Apply Privacy Setting to Destinations
steps: When editing, open popup showing destination lists (included/not included).
User can add/remove destinations using UI buttons (AddLeft, AddRight, AddAll, RemoveAll).
On save, SiteContactPrivacyAppliedDestinationsAssign is called with selected destination IDs.

business_rules: Withhold days must be a non-negative integer, or -1 if 'Always' is checked.
Only users with edit permissions can modify privacy settings.
Existing privacy entries are updated if present; otherwise, new ones are created.
validations: CompareValidator controls ensure days input is valid (numeric, non-negative).
If input is invalid, IsValid flags are set to false and save is aborted.
calculations: Otherwise, days value is taken from the user input.
conditions: If user session is invalid, revert input to last saved value.
If withhold checkbox is unchecked and entry exists, delete it.
If ParentIDName is 'CourseID', some help messages/divs are hidden.
system_behavior: After save or delete, redirects to current or default page depending on context.
On page pre-render, loads current privacy settings.
dependencies: Resources for UI labels and help text.
Session state for user and page context.
exceptions: If no entry exists and user unchecks withhold, nothing is saved.
content_gaps: The documentation covers the structure, UI logic, and most handler behavior, but the concrete implementation and logic of GenericContactPrivacies and Codes objects are not included.
No user-facing documentation, so exact UI behavior (like messages shown, error details) is inferred from field and method names.
Destination code assignment workflow is described but specific rules are only represented in method calls, not full detail.
